I am writing to apologise for missing our planning meeting in connection with a digital learning workshop. I understand that this caused inconvenience, and I take responsibility for not informing you sooner.

I am writing to apologise for [lỗi cần xin lỗi — V-ing] in connection with [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I understand that this caused inconvenience, and I take responsibility for not informing you sooner.
